Student Ambassador & Outreach Program Management
Recruits, trains, supervises, and evaluates student ambassadors who support high school and community college outreach.
Develops training curriculum and leadership pathways for ambassadors.
Implements ambassador assignments to support MAAP, SIP, and other strategic partnerships across the Central Valley and beyond.
Oversees ambassador-led presentations, college fair participation, and school visits.
Campus Visit Experience and Welcome Center Oversight
Manages the UC Merced Welcome Center including daily operations, front-line visitor services, and coordination with Admissions Events staff.
Develops and manages all campus tour offerings—individual, group, VIP, and virtual.
Maintains tour reservation systems, data collection tools, and visit evaluation processes.
Crafts and regularly updates tour scripts and visit messaging in collaboration with Marketing.
SAPEP Student Initiative Program (SIP) Management
Provides admissions advising for prospective students and families during campus visits and outreach events.
Coordinates with regional reps and internal teams to support campus-based and off-site outreach efforts.
Manages SIP budget, including the distribution and awarding of SIP funds to applicants.
Pre-Admissions Advising and Recruitment Events
Tracks and analyzes visit attendance, tour feedback, and ambassador participation metrics.
Develops monthly and annual reports for internal and external stakeholders.
Collaborates with Marketing and Analysis to produce digital content, ambassador stories, and visitor communications.
Data, Evaluation, Communication, and Reporting
Tracks and analyzes visit attendance, tour feedback, and ambassador participation metrics.
Develops monthly and annual reports for internal and external stakeholders.

Collaborates with Marketing and Analysis to produce digital content, ambassador stories, and visitor communications. Evaluates the effectiveness of the Ambassador Program in meeting UC and campus enrollment goals.
Advanced degree in Higher Education, Leadership, or Student Development, or related field from an accredited institution. Preferred
Licenses and Certifications
Valid US Drivers License & Participation in the CA DMV Pull Program.
Minimum 5 years experience working in higher education.
Bilingual proficiency and experience serving diverse student populations. Preferred
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
Knowledge and experience working with a diverse student population.
Working knowledge of UC Merced, and the ability to interpret policies and procedures to prospective applicants and the public.
Working knowledge of academic programs, including curricula, admissions requirements, and financial aid programs, at UC Merced.
Ability to establish and maintain cooperative relationships with schools, universities, community organizations, and other institutions.
Working/ knowledge of admissions requirements for campus/school/college.
Ability to develop recruitment programs, and design effective materials.
Experience in managing student staff and their supervision.
Good to strong assessment and reporting knowledge.

This position will be required to complete all pre-employment requirements, including a background investigation, the University's credentialing process, and verification of licensure and/or certification through the appropriate California licensing or certifying board(s), as applicable.
Background check  required.
